claims.assertion: Anéeka says groups coordinate by dominant local time perception; Earth orbit uses Earth dates.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Taygeta and Cyndriel are described as difficult cases.

claims.assertion: She says telepathy is the main coordination method, with stellar positions as another time reference.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says synchronized clocks quickly desynchronize in Taygeta because perception varies among individuals.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Solar position gives only an approximate measure.

claims.assertion: She says Cyndriel has no night because Aldebaran dominates its sky; a Taygetan colony lives there.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She attributes limited heating to radiation frequency and a dense nebula.
